# `mise dotfiles conflicts`

- **用法：** `mise dotfiles conflicts [--difftool] [--tool <TOOL>] [PATH]…`
- **作用：** 只读
- **源代码：** [`src/cli/dotfiles/conflicts.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/dotfiles/conflicts.rs)

Compare both sides of a sync conflict

Prints a unified diff from this machine's saved version to the version fetched from the origin. `--difftool` opens the comparison in Git's configured diff tool; when `diff.tool` is unset, Git falls back to `merge.tool`. This command changes neither side. Resolve a conflict with `mise dot pull --take-remote` or `--keep-local`.

## 参数
- **`[PATH]…`** — 仅检查这些存在冲突的路径

## 标志
- **`--difftool`** — 在 Git 配置的 diff 或 merge 工具中打开比较
- **`--tool <TOOL>`** — 使用此 Git diff 工具，而不是配置的默认工具
- **`-h --help`** — 打印帮助

## Examples

Show every conflict

```
mise dot conflicts
```

Show one conflicted file

```
mise dot conflicts ~/.zshrc
```

Open the comparison in Git's diff tool

```
mise dot conflicts --difftool ~/.zshrc
```

Use a specific diff tool

```
mise dot conflicts --difftool --tool meld ~/.zshrc
```
